messages:
Alex K: Quick thread — we need a migration incentive ladder to move appliance/private-offer customers to cloud marketplace private offers. Objectives: maintain net ARR, limit credit exposure, enable HW+SI co-selling. Brainstorm options.
Maria G: Finance constraints: revenue recognition rules for marketplace credits; we need a simple cap and a lookback on usage. Recommend cap at 25% total credit unless approved by RevOps.
Chris P: Operational: must map appliance SKU -> marketplace SKU. Without clear mapping we can't forecast costs. Also define a 120-day migration window after signing to claim migration credits.
Sophie L: SI POV: recommend implementation credit tiering based on commit size; can offer onboarding credits plus a success fee tied to go-live. Example tiers in sample CSV.
Jon (partner-eng): HW partners want an attachable line-item and a rebate claim flow. They prefer rebate paid as co-sell discount on invoice rather than separate rebate.
Liam (hw-pm): We can support up to 7% rebate in most cases, higher for hardware refresh cycles. Need legal-approved wording for channel partner claims.
pricing-bot: Proposed ladder YAML (pasted as CSV for easy review):
```
tier,commit_min_yr,market_disc,mig_bonus,si_onboard,hw_attach_rebate,credit_cap
bronze,120000,8%,5%,20%,5%,20%
silver,300000,12%,10%,30%,7%,25%
gold,750000,18%,15%,40%,10%,25%
```
Alex K: I like bronze/silver/gold naming for clarity. Note: migration bonus applies only if migration completes within the 120-day SLA and customer signs marketing release for joint announcement.
Maria G: Also require marketplace approvals: any deal where combined discounts exceed 20% must pass Marketplace Ops and RevOps. We'll own the approval flow.
Chris P: Add guardrail: if marketplace SKU mapping isn't available, fallback to a 6-month Dedicated credit with intent-to-convert clause. That avoids blocking customer momentum.
Sophie L: For SI credits, propose clawbacks if customer churns within 90 days post-migration. Success fee paid 30 days after go-live.
Jon (partner-eng): HW rebate claim window = 45 days post-invoice. We'll add a simple contractor form for claims; legal to vet contract addendum.
Alex K: Marketing: target joint announcement 30	60 days after go-live, only with signed release. SI+HW logos optional; customer approval required.
pricing-bot: Reminder: cap formula = min(credit_cap, sum(market_disc,mig_bonus,si_onboard,hw_attach_rebate)).
Maria G: Action owners: Maria -> revops/approval flow; Chris -> SKU mapping & revenue model; Sophie -> SI T&Cs & clawback language; Jon -> HW rebate process & addendum; Liam -> HW engineering readiness for attached SKU.
Chris P: I'll pull appliance -> marketplace SKU mapping from eng-infra and prototype cost sim by Wed.
Sophie L: I'll draft T&Cs and sample customer language for marketing release by Tue.
Jon (partner-eng): I'll get legal into the loop and draft the rebate claim form by Wed.
Alex K: Let's reconvene Fri 10:30am PT for final sign-off. Please update the shared spreadsheet with numbers before then. :thumbsup:
